episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: After being resurrected and pulled two and a half centuries through time, Ichabod Crane finds himself in modern-day Sleepy Hollow, where he quickly realizes that evil has awoken with him. When Sheriff August Corbin is killed by the infamous Headless Horseman, Ichabod forms an unlikely bond with Detective Abbie Mills, a young cop who has her own childhood supernatural experiences. Together, the two embark on a mission to stop evil and uncover mysteries dating back to the founding of our country. Captain Frank Irving hesitates to believe Ichabod's tales of supernatural evil. But when Ichabod's former wife, Katrina, provides clues about impending evil, they all begin to realize that this town is anything but sleepy.

episodes.title: Blood Moon
episodes.summary: Still adjusting to his 21st century reality, Ichabod Crane and Det. Abbie Mills move forward in their mission to unravel the mysteries lurking in Sleepy Hollow. A frightful vision from Ichabod's former wife Katrina, sends the unlikely duo on the hunt for a vengeful witch from the 1700s who has been awoken by unknown evils and is on a path of destruction in the quaint town. Meanwhile, despite all odds, Officer Andy Brooks is back and on a questionable mission of his own.

episodes.title: For the Triumph of Evil
episodes.summary: Another soldier in the army of evil, the Sandman, seeps into the dreams of the residents of Sleepy Hollow. By infiltrating their minds at night, he tortures them to the brink - all because they, at one time, turned a blind eye to justice. When the Sandman seemingly sets his sights on Abbie, she is forced to begin to face her past - and her institutionalized sister Jenny. With Ichabod by her side, and her life at stake, the duo must try to defeat the Sandman and continue their fight against evil.

episodes.title: The Lesser Key of Solomon
episodes.summary: Lt. Abbie Mills and Ichabod Crane search for Abbie's estranged sister, Jenny, who has escaped from a Sleepy Hollow psychiatric hospital. In a game-changing episode, which includes flashbacks to the real Boston Tea Party, Abbie and Ichabod discover more about the evil they are facing... and finally learn its name.

episodes.title: John Doe
episodes.summary: When an unidentified boy is discovered in Sleepy Hollow, Ichabod Crane and Lt. Abbie Mills are called to the scene. After speaking with the child, they immediately realize that something sinister and sickly is afoot and the duo go on a hunt to discover his home and origins - and are shocked by what they find.

episodes.title: The Sin Eater
episodes.summary: When Ichabod Crane goes missing, his wife, Katrina, appears to Lt. Abbie Mills in a vision warning her that the Headless Horseman will return to Sleepy Hollow by nightfall. A frantic Abbie seeks help from the mysterious Henry Parrish, who holds vital clues about how Crane can vanquish his dangerous blood tie to the Horseman. Meanwhile, an encounter from Crane's past weighs heavily on him, and details about his first encounter with Katrina are revealed.

episodes.title: The Midnight Ride
episodes.summary: Abbie and Ichabod must find hidden clues to thwart the evil in Sleepy Hollow and Abbie gets an unexpected visit from the enigmatic Andy Brooks.

episodes.title: Necromancer
episodes.summary: Ichabod, Abbie, Captain Irving and Jenny Mills join forces and face the Headless Horseman. While staring down this nemesis, Ichabod is shocked by game-changing information about the Horseman’s true motive.

episodes.title: Sanctuary
episodes.summary: When Ichabod and Abbie investigate a missing persons case, the search leads to a colonial-era house which holds secrets from Ichabod’s past...and unleashes a long-dormant evil.

episodes.title: The Golem
episodes.summary: Ichabod enlists Henry Parrish to help him communicate with Katrina, but in the process, a menacing danger is unleashed from purgatory.

episodes.title: The Vessel
episodes.summary: When Capt. Iriving's daughter, Macy, becomes the target of evil forces, he makes a desperate plea to Crane and Mills for help, and seeks answers that lie within Washington's Bible. Meanwhile, a frightening chapter of Jenny's past is revealed.

episodes.title: The Indispensable Man
episodes.summary: Ichabod and Abbie discover a massive secret buried within the pages of George Washington's Bible and unearth the shocking true nature of the founding father's death. Meanwhile, Captain Irving makes a near-impossible decision for the sake of his beloved family that drastically changes his future.

episodes.title: Bad Blood
episodes.summary: The battle between good and evil comes to an explosive head – sacrifices must be made, worlds collide, loyalties are tested and the town of Sleepy Hollow will never be the same.

episodes.title: This Is War
episodes.summary: Picking up immediately after the spellbinding events of the Season One finale, Ichabod finds himself buried alive in a coffin; Abbie is trapped in purgatory; Ichabod's wife, Katrina, has been kidnapped by the Headless Horseman; Capt. Frank Irving is behind bars for a murder he did not commit; and Abbie's sister, Jenny, is among the wreckage of a horrific car crash. These events were due, in large part, to the shocking revelation that Henry Parish, the trusted friend of Ichabod and Abbie, is actually Ichabod and Katrina's son and the Second Horseman of the Apocalypse. Now, with Henry's emergence as the Horseman of War, alongside the Headless Horseman.

episodes.title: The Kindred
episodes.summary: Ichabod Crane and Lt. Abbie Mills concoct a daring plan to try to rescue Ichabod's wife, Katrina, from the Headless Horseman by resurrecting a Frankenstein-like monster created by Benjamin Franklin. Meanwhile, Frank Irving faces new trouble after revealing the true details of his encounter with a demon, and Jenny Mills finds herself at odds with the new sheriff in town.

episodes.title: Root of All Evil
episodes.summary: After a bank robbery turns violent, Abbie and Ichabod embark on a hunt for a mysterious silver coin that has more power than meets the eye. Meanwhile, Captain Frank Irving is put in a position where he must choose between his family and the greater good and the Mills' sisterly bond is put to the utmost test.

episodes.title: Go Where I Send Thee...
episodes.summary: Abbie and Crane's search for a missing Sleepy Hollow child reveals a creature akin to the Pied Piper, whose legacy with the child's family extends back to a centuries-old curse.

episodes.title: The Weeping Lady
episodes.summary: A woman from Ichabod Crane's past comes to Sleepy Hollow in the form of an un-dead Weeping Lady, aiming to harm anyone in her path. Katrina and Crane learn unsettling things about each other's pasts. Abbie has some unexpected flirtatious encounters.

episodes.title: And the Abyss Gazes Back
episodes.summary: Sheriff Corbin's son returns from war, but his strange behavior leads Abbie and Ichabod to question his intentions.

episodes.title: Deliverance
episodes.summary: Abbie and Ichabod learn that Katrina is in imminent danger and race against the clock to help her.

episodes.title: Heartless
episodes.summary: Crane and Abbie set out to take down a succubus whom Henry has sent out to drain the life forces out of its victims.

episodes.title: Mama
episodes.summary: Series of mysterious deaths at Tarrytown Psych leads Abbie and Ichabod to discover that an especially surprising spirit is involved.

episodes.title: Magnum Opus
episodes.summary: Abbie and Ichabod are on a quest to find a weapon of ultimate power to kill Moloch - the Sword of Methuselah - before the Headless Horseman can stop them.

episodes.title: The Akeda
episodes.summary: Unforeseen sacrifices must be made and loyalties are put to the ultimate test in the fight against evil.

episodes.title: Paradise Lost
episodes.summary: Reeling from the events of their standoff with Moloch, Ichabod and Abbie encounter an angel, Orion, that they believe can help them. Meanwhile, Katrina searches for the humanity in Abraham.

episodes.title: Pittura Infamante
episodes.summary: After the mysterious death of an art restorer at the Sleepy Hollow Historical Society Soiree, Ichabod and Katrina are reminded of a dear friend from their past - Abigail Adams. Meanwhile, Abbie is shocked by someone's visit to the police precinct.

episodes.title: Kali Yuga
episodes.summary: With the help of Ichabod, Abbie and Jenny, Nick Hawley faces off against his evil childhood caretaker, and Captain Frank Irving adjusts to his new... life.....

episodes.title: Spellcaster
episodes.summary: After escaping Purgatory, a warlock who triggered the Salem witch trials returns to find a dangerous book of spells. Meanwhile, Abbie attempts to trust Frank Irving again, while Henry struggles to find his identity.

episodes.title: What Lies Beneath
episodes.summary: Ichabod and Abbie face demonic creatures that guard a secret crypt and encounter Thomas Jefferson in their quest to fight evil. Meanwhile, Jenny learns a shocking secret about Frank Irving.

episodes.title: Awakening
episodes.summary: Ichabod and Abbie fight against those who want to re-awaken a powerful witch coven and Jenny learns a disturbing truth about Frank Irving.

episodes.title: Tempus Fugit
episodes.summary: Abbie is trapped in 1781 and must convince Ichabod that they are partners in the future. Meanwhile, Katrina persuades the Horseman to ally with her so that she can kill Ichabod and change the future.

episodes.title: I, Witness
episodes.summary: After the deaths of Henry and Katrina, Ichabod goes to find himself while Abbie joins the FBI. However, the discovery of an ancient tablet brings Ichabod back to the U.S. and the Witnesses discover that the Second Tribulation may be starting.

episodes.title: Whispers in the Dark
episodes.summary: When Pandora uses her powers to unleash a new form of evil, Abbie and Crane are forced to face their pasts in unexpected ways.

episodes.title: Blood and Fear
episodes.summary: Pandora resurrects an ancient evil from Ichabod's past to terrorize Sleepy Hollow. Meanwhile, Jenny takes Joe along to track down the Shard's thief, and Daniel offers to clear the air with Abbie.

episodes.title: The Sisters Mills
episodes.summary: Pandora summons a new monster to terrorize Sleepy Hollow: the Abyzou, which steals the souls of children who are losing their teeth. Meanwhile, Abbie tells Jenn that she has found their father, and Ichabod goes to the dentist.

episodes.title: Dead Men Tell No Tales
episodes.summary: Pandora resurrects Ichabod's nemesis General Howe to lead an army of undead warriors on Sleepy Hollow. To stop Howe, the Witnesses need to find his tomb and turn to Brennan and Booth for help.

episodes.title: This Red Lady from Caribee
episodes.summary: Pandora unleashes a monster that triggers waves of paranoia in its victims, followed by death. While Ichabod and Abbie hunt it down, Joe meets with Atticus to find out more about his father.

episodes.title: The Art of War
episodes.summary: Daniel leaves Abbie in charge while he goes to DC on the Nevins case. Meanwhile, Atticus summons three berserkers to recover the energy from the Shard of Anubis, and Ichabod, Abbie, and Joe close ranks to protect Abbie's sister.

episodes.title: Novus Ordo Seclorum
episodes.summary: Pandora nurses the Hidden One back to health, but he requires the Eye to regain his energies... and the Eye rests within Jenny. Meanwhile, Abbie resigns from the FBI so that she's free to go after the Witnesses' enemies with Joe and Ichabod.

episodes.title: One Life
episodes.summary: Ichabod is obsessed with finding his missing partner Abbie. Meanwhile, Joe and Jenny look for a map that can lead them to Pandora, and Sophia receives her first taste of the supernatural when she helps Ichabod battle a Japanese vengeance demon.

episodes.title: Incident at Stone Manor
episodes.summary: While Ichabod quests on the astral plane to find the missing Abbie, Sophie comes to Joe and Jenny and asks for their help dealing with a living Gargoyle that has already killed one man.

episodes.title: Kindred Spirits
episodes.summary: As Abbie re-acclimates to a normal life after returning from Purgatory, Daniel calls her in to investigate a series of grisly murders. She and Ichabod realize that the murders are due to a mistake that they met in the past. Meanwhile, Pandora contemplates the loss of her powers.

episodes.title: Sins of the Father
episodes.summary: Atticus Nevins returns to Sleepy Hollow and the group easily captures him. He explains that he unearthed a Ghoul during his time in Iraq--with August Corbin--and the group needs him to stop the creature. However, things aren't entirely as they seem. Meanwhile, Jenny meets with Ezra while Abbie contiues to cope with her time in Purgatory.

episodes.title: Dark Mirror
episodes.summary: While Ichabod and Abbie deal with a creature from Ichabod's past with ties to the Hidden One, Joe realizes that he's overstepped his boundaries with Jenny.

episodes.title: Into the Wild
episodes.summary: While Abbie and Sophie try to deal with a 400-year-old monster while on an FBI field exercise, Ichabod investigates the symbol while Joe and Jenny try to recover a fragment of Pandora's Box at auction.

episodes.title: Incommunicado
episodes.summary: The Hidden One attacks Ichabod in the archive... and traps them both when the Emblem activates. Abbie is forced to ally with Pandora to remove the mystic barrier before it's too late, but the price Pandora demands may be too high.

episodes.title: Dawn's Early Light
episodes.summary: Pandora betrays the Hidden One when she realizes that he will never consider her as an equal, and makes her stand with humanity. Meanwhile, Ichabod and Abbie realize that the Founding Fathers' flag--the one that Betsy created--holds the key to returning to the Catacombs and seek it out... putting a deadly guardian on their trail.

episodes.title: Delaware
episodes.summary: As Pandora and Daniel join the team to stop the Hidden One from destroying the world, Ichabod and Abbie find their way into Purgatory and make their way to the Catacombs. There they find an unexpected ally from Ichabod's past.

episodes.title: Ragnarok
episodes.summary: After escaping the Catacombs with the reassembled Box, Abbie and Ichabod free Pandora to help them defeat the Hidden One. However, the cure may prove worse than the disease, and Ichabod calls upon a former opponent for help.

episodes.title: Columbia
episodes.summary: After escaping his captors in DC, Ichabod teams up with Homeland Security Agent Diana Thomas, who just lost her partner to a demon attack. Together they find what remains of George Washington's Agency 355 and try to stop the demon. Meanwhile, Ichabod tries to find the new Witness.

episodes.title: In Plain Sight
episodes.summary: Ichabod, Diana, and Jenny go after two witches who have killed their sister and are setting out to destroy any liars that they find in DC. Meanwhile, Ichabod and Jenny discover the identity of the new Witness.

episodes.title: Heads of State
episodes.summary: Jake and Alex finally confront Ichabod with what they've deduced about his origins. Meanwhile, the Horseman goes after the most powerful head in Washington... the President.

episodes.title: The People vs. Ichabod Crane
episodes.summary: Ichabod is ensnared by a spider demon and forced to stand trial for the death of Abbie in a courtroom taken from his imagination... and with an unexpected face as the prosecutor. Meanwhile, the others attempt to feel Ichabod from his imprisonment.

episodes.title: Blood from a Stone
episodes.summary: Malcolm's former partner returns from Hell and seeks the pieces of the artifact for himself... just as Ichabod and Diana pay Malcolm a visit. Meanwhile, Diana considers how to tell Molly the truth.

episodes.title: Homecoming
episodes.summary: Team Witness goes to Sleepy Hollow to recover the fourth piece of the Stone, only to discover that Malcolm and Jobe are one step ahead of them. Now Malcolm plans to reunite the talismans and use the completed Stone to give himself eternal life.

episodes.title: Loco Parentis
episodes.summary: Molly's father Mitch returns from Afghanistan and expresses an interest in restarting his relationship with his ex-wife and daughter. Meanwhile, Jenny imprisons Jobe and questions him as to Malcolm's intentions.

episodes.title: Sick Burn
episodes.summary: An Internet video contains an ancient symbol that spreads a supernatural combustion disease to anyone who watches it. to save Alex, Jake exposes himself to the video in an attempt to fire her before it's too late. Meanwhile, Malcolm assembles his own team to bring about his vision for America.

episodes.title: Child's Play
episodes.summary: An imaginary friend from Molly's childhood materializes and starts attacking those close to her. Meanwhile, Molly and Ichabod are sealed in the Vault, and Jake and Alex find their predecessor's home.

episodes.title: Insatiable
episodes.summary: Malcolm has Jobe unleash a demon as part of his master plan to become President of America. Meanwhile, Diana questions whether her priorities and the team's are the same.

episodes.title: The Way of the Gun
episodes.summary: The team splits up: Diana and Ichabod try to recover the Totem of War before Malcolm obtains it, while Jenny, Jake, and Alex try to track down Malcolm's. However, a mysterious woman who seems to know all the team's secrets interferes, trying to destroy the Totem before anyone else can get it.

episodes.title: Tomorrow
episodes.summary: Jobe resurrects the Hessians to recharge Death's totem, and then turns them loose on Sleepy Hollow. While Jenny, Alex, and Jake try to stop them, Diana and Lara try to free Ichabod's soul from the Avatar of War before it's too late. Meanwhile, Henry is resurrected and assures the team that he's on their side.

episodes.title: Freedom
episodes.summary: Malcolm uses the Horsemen to capture the President, and prepares to conquer the U.S. Only Team Witness, a secret cache of weapons, and a deal with the Devil can stop him.
